questions.question: Day 7 Vocabulary (Performance Reviews & Goals): What is the exact practical meaning of the phrase 'call off'?

options.a: To perform a daily task hastily without preparation.
options.b: To postpone or cancel an activity indefinitely.
options.c: To clean or inspect a physical room thoroughly.
options.d: Cancel a planned event or meeting.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option D
'call off' means: cancel a planned event or meeting. Example: "They had to call off the afternoon presentation."

questions.question:
Day 7 Translation Scenario 1 (Performance Reviews & Goals):

Telugu: "నేను సాధారణంగా ఉదయం 6 గంటలకే నిద్రలేచి ఒక కప్పు టీ తాగుతాను."
(Literal attempt: "I generally in morning 6 clock wake up drink tea.")

options.a: I am needing to i generally in morning 6 clock wake up drink tea.
options.b: Literal Indian English phrasing without modal polite verbs.
options.c: I usually wake up at 6:00 AM and have a cup of tea.
options.d: I generally in morning 6 clock wake up drink tea.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option C
Natural Version: "I usually wake up at 6:00 AM and have a cup of tea."

Use 'have a cup of tea' and specify time as '6:00 AM'.

questions.question:
Day 7 Translation Scenario 2 (Performance Reviews & Goals):

(Literal attempt: "Brother bus stand drop me, how much will become?")

options.a: Please drop me off near the bus stand. How much is the fare?
options.b: Brother bus stand drop me, how much will become?
options.c: I am needing to brother bus stand drop me, how much will become?
options.d: Literal Indian English phrasing without modal polite verbs.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option A
Natural Version: "Please drop me off near the bus stand. How much is the fare?"

Avoid 'how much will become' and ask 'How much is the fare?'.
